about_short_description.short_description: Melder is an AI platform that organize the supply chain data in a simple spreadsheet tool and identify cost savings opportunities.

product.name: Melder Excel Add-in
product.description: An Excel add-in that integrates AI functions to automate data analysis, generate summaries, and extract information from various sources within spreadsheets.

product.name: Data Rooms Analysis
product.description: A service that extracts insights from data rooms by tracking files, identifying information gaps, and automatically extracting financial and organizational metrics.

product.name: Contract Review
product.description: A tool that identifies key terms, clauses, and potential risks in contracts, summarizes obligations, and tracks negotiation points and revisions.

product.name: Market Research
product.description: A service that gathers and analyzes competitor data, customer feedback, and industry trends to inform strategic decisions and identify market opportunities.

product.name: Transcript Synthesis
product.description: A service that extracts insights, summarizes key themes, and tracks action items from expert interviews, customer feedback, and meeting recordings.
